entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, um, I was hoping to make a return. I bought a helmet a little while ago and it's just not going to work out.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy, or an email address I can use to look up the purchase?
Thank you, Sadie. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Crestline Helmet, delivered on December 27th. What specifically is the issue with it?

Oh, it's just... the photos online made the color look so vibrant, but in person, it's much duller. I know it sounds silly, but I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited for it. Now it just makes me sad to look at it.
I understand. Getting the right gear that you feel good in is important, especially when it comes to safety equipment.
Exactly. And it's still in the box, unopened and everything. I just feel so guilty about it sitting there. I really was counting on getting that money back for some bills. I hope it's not too late.
Let me check the return eligibility for you right now. I see it was delivered 32 days ago. Just one moment...
Okay, good news. That helmet is a standard item, and you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? You can? Oh, that is such a huge relief. Thank you so, so much. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Not a problem at all, Sadie. I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to you. Please attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
That's perfect. You've really made my day, David. Thank you for being so helpful.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great afternoon.
